summary: Barkol Dahe Airport is a regional airport serving Barkol Kazakh Autonomous County in the Hami Prefecture of Xinjiang, China. Situated on the edge of the Barkol grasslands, it primarily supports domestic flights connecting this remote northwestern region to major hubs. The airport plays a key role in facilitating access to an area renowned for its Kazakh heritage, historic ruins, and high-altitude steppe landscapes.
faqs:
Q: What is the airport code for Barkol Dahe Airport?
A: The IATA code is DHH and the ICAO code is ZWLK.

Q: Where is Barkol Dahe Airport located?
A: It is located in Barkol Kazakh Autonomous County, part of Hami Prefecture in Xinjiang, northwestern China.

Q: Are there international flights from Barkol Dahe Airport?
A: No, the airport primarily handles domestic flights within China.

Q: What is the best time to visit Barkol?
A: Summer (June to August) is ideal, when the grasslands are green and weather conditions are most favorable for travel.
transport_tips: The airport is located a short drive from Barkol town center, and taxis or pre-arranged hotel transfers are the most common ways to reach it. There is no rail service directly to the airport, so road transport is essential. Travelers arriving should arrange ground transportation in advance, as public transport options at the airport are limited.
local_tip: If visiting Barkol, take time to explore the ancient Barkol Ancient City ruins and experience authentic Kazakh yurt stays on the surrounding grasslands—activities that make this remote region culturally distinctive.
